title: Single-pole opamp macromodel with slew limit and rail clamp
description: Differential DC gain av0 with one dominant pole placed so the unity-gain bandwidth is gbw; output rate of change is smoothly limited to slew; the output clamps to [vlo, vhi] against the vss reference behind a thevenin rout. Small-signal transconductance at balance is exact; the tanh input stage softens the slew corner.

output_drive.edge_convention: continuous; slew applies to the internal integrator node

parameters.name: slew
parameters.description: Large-signal output slew limit (smooth tanh corner).

state.name: integrator node
state.value_before_first_event: The OP solution places the integrator at its balanced value for the applied differential input.

unsupported.behavior: Noise contributions are absent, not zero-modeled; report noise as unavailable.

regularization.name: fixed internal integrator capacitance
regularization.scaling_rule: gm, tail current, and r1 are solved from av0/gbw/slew against fixed c1x
regularization.tested_error_bound: av0 and gbw each within 0.1% of declared values; slew within 3% (tanh softening)

limitations: Single pole only: no second pole, no phase-margin model beyond the dominant pole.
No input offset, bias current, common-mode rejection, or supply-rejection model.
Clamp is a hard max/min on the internal node: recovery from deep saturation has no overload time constant.
